mina: Quick note  onboarding marverna11b HF-conversion + int4 showed odd summarization regressions vs fp16.
omar: How big?
mina: Small table from smoke run:
mina: ```
model                | rouge1 | next-ppl | lat/token
marv-fp16            | 0.44   | 9.8      | 13ms
marv-int4            | 0.36   | 14.5     | 6.1ms
marv-int4-remap      | 0.42   | 10.9     | 6.3ms
```
mina: Remap = runtime head_map-aware sincos. Recovers most quality.
lee: Converter normalized head groups? weve seen converters collapse per_head_dims.
mina: Yep. On-disk header vs converted diff: upstream had per_head_dims and explicit head_map; converter dropped per_head_dims and flattened groups.
omar: That will mis-index rotary cos/sin and kv-cache stride. Any token remap issues?
mina: Token mapping preserved, but we saw punctuation shift in a handful of examples. Could be amplified by wrong rotary.
lee: Plan: 1) re-run conversion preserving head_map, 2) quick int4 with rotary-disabled, 3) run logit-diff/topk on 200 prompts.
mina: Scheduling jobs now. devops-bot: Queued jobs: 1755701234-01 reconvert-preserve-headmap, 1755701234-02 int4-rotary-disabled, 1755701234-03 logit-diff-200. ETA ~1h.
omar: If reconversion fixes, add CI test for roundtrip head_map + sincos index. Also gate auto-quant to warn on head_map normalization.
lee: Also try per-channel calibration for proj matrices as a quick softening step.
mina: Will post results. Thanks :v:
